governanceNotes: D1 batch 30 (2026-09-23): deferred. Erythema nodosum is a reactive panniculitis defined by its response to upstream triggers (streptococcal infection, sarcoidosis, inflammatory bowel disease, medications, pregnancy), so any outgoing edge to a catalog target restates either the presentation of a listed driver (sarcoidosis, inflammatory-bowel-disease and reactive-arthritis identities already carry edges) or a co-occurring manifestation of the same driver (ankle arthralgia in Löfgren syndrome parallels the EN lesions as parallel expressions of the sarcoidosis process) - a shared-upstream-driver confound that defeats an EN-attributable outcome claim (batch-22 diabetes-mellitus and batch-23 diplopia precedents).

The arthritis co-occurrence literature is Löfgren-syndrome scoped with no EN-specific attribution cohort; ulceration is not a feature of EN (that belongs to erythema induratum). Reopening condition: cohort evidence of an EN-attributable outcome independent of the driving disease would justify re-screening.
